p: Which might put him in remembrance of his deliverance.
haste: He teaches us to be earnest in prayer even though God seems to delay: for at his time he will hear us.
confounded that seek after my soul: He was assured that the more they raged, the nearer they were to destruction, and he the nearer to his deliverance.
shame that say: By this we are taught not to mock at others in their misery, lest the same fall on our own necks.
poor and needy: Because he had felt God's help before, he grounds on experience, and boldly seeks him for help.
